topic: Belcour-Barla Snell-refracted thin-film iridescence OPD vs naive unrefracted incident-cosine phase collapse rig
topic_zh: Belcour-Barla 斯涅尔折射薄膜干涉光程差对比朴素未折射入射余弦伪彩虹坍缩
scope: Deterministic Laurent Belcour & Pascal Barla (SIGGRAPH 2017 / MaterialX / glTF KHR_materials_iridescence) Snell-refracted thin-film optical path difference ratio (cos(theta_t) = sqrt(1 - sin^2(theta_i) / n_film^2) with d = 400 nm, n_film = 1.50, normal OPD = 1200 nm) versus naive unrefracted incident cosine (cos(theta_i)) and 64-layer transfer-matrix wavefront propagation across 17 incident viewing angles (theta_i in [0 deg, 80 deg]).

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Closed-form Snell radical evaluation versus 64-layer trigonometric transfer-matrix wavefront integration.

protocol.function: cos θ_t = √(1 − sin²θ_i / n_film²) → 60° OPD Ratio = 0.8165 (979.8nm) vs Unrefracted cos 60° = 0.5000 (−38.76% Collapse)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 incident viewing angles preserve Snell critical-cone optical path bounds without grazing rainbow collapse

good_fit: Soap bubbles, scarab beetle shells, anodized titanium, mother-of-pearl, and anti-reflective lens coatings in glTF KHR_materials_iridescence, MaterialX, Blender, and Three.js
Bounding grazing-angle optical path difference inside the Snell critical cone (cos(theta_t) >= sqrt(1 - 1/n^2) = 0.7454 for n=1.50)
Preventing the -38.76% at 60° and -76.94% at 80° false multi-order rainbow cycling of unrefracted cos(theta_i) shaders
Evaluating exact refracted cosine from dot(N, V) in 3 algebraic operations plus 1 square root without inverse trig
not_for: Non-iridescent opaque matte paints or uncoated bulk metals without a dielectric film layer
Diffraction gratings (CD/DVD tracks, holographic foil) governed by surface groove pitch d*sin(theta) rather than thin-film thickness
Cholesteric liquid crystals with helical Bragg pitch rotation
